text:
Predicates:
SportingEvent(x) ::: x is a sporting event.
LastEvent(x) ::: x is the last of its kind.
Location(x, y) ::: x took place in location y.
WonMostMedals(x, y) ::: x won the most medals in event y.
Country(x) ::: x is a country.
UnitedStates(x) ::: x is the United States.
Tokyo(x) ::: x is Tokyo.
Premises:
SportingEvent(summerOlympics) ::: The summer Olympic games is a sporting event.
LastEvent(summerOlympicsInTokyo) ::: The last summer Olympic games was in Tokyo.
Location(summerOlympicsInTokyo, Tokyo) ::: The last summer Olympic games was in Tokyo.
WonMostMedals(UnitedStates, summerOlympicsInTokyo) ::: The United States won the most medals in Tokyo.
Conclusion:
WonMostMedals(UnitedStates, summerOlympicsInTokyo) ::: The United States won the most medals in the last summer Olympic games.
